pred_diagnosis: Acute Myocardial Infarction with Normal Coronary Arteries

1: The patient presented with chest pain and ST-segment elevation in leads V2 and V3, which are consistent with acute myocardial infarction. The resolution of ST-segment elevations after treatment and the presence of normal coronary arteries on angiography further support this diagnosis.
2: The patient has right ventricular dilatation and an estimated pulmonary arterial pressure of 60 mmHg, which are consistent with right ventricular strain. The presence of chest pain also supports this diagnosis.
